Visitor reformats links using template interpolation

```typescript title="TypeScript"
import { convert } from "@xberg-io/html-to-markdown";
function main() {
  const _testVisitor = {
    visitLink(ctx: unknown, href: unknown, text: unknown, title: unknown): string | { custom: string } {
        return { custom: `${text} (${href})` };
    },

    }

  const result = convert("<p>Visit <a href=\"https://example.com\">Example</a> for more info.</p>", { visitor: _testVisitor as never });
  console.log(result.content);
}
```
